roundLabel: Round 3 · Moving Day at Sea Island
headline: The RSM Classic: Moving Day underway as Thorbjornsen, Penge, and Neergaard-Petersen share lead at -9
teaser: Moving Day is live at Sea Island where a three-way tie atop the leaderboard at 9-under par sets the tone for weekend survival battles and 2027 Tour card drama.
story:
Round 3 of The RSM Classic got underway in crisp, breezy conditions on Saturday morning, 21 November, at Sea Island Golf Club on St. Simons Island, Georgia, with the field condensed onto the par-70 Seaside Course for the weekend.

Following a dramatic 36-hole cut that fell at 2-under par, 65 players advanced to Moving Day. Young American talent Michael Thorbjornsen, England's Marco Penge, and Denmark's Rasmus Neergaard-Petersen share the 36-hole clubhouse lead at 9-under-par 131, setting up a high-stakes duel across the coastal marshlands.

For the players hovering near the top-125 cutoff in the FedExCup Fall standings, Saturday represents the pivotal round. Joel Dahmen safely survived the cut on the 2-under line to keep his 2027 PGA Tour playing privileges alive, while local favorite Davis Thompson enters Moving Day within striking distance at 5-under par.

stakes: The winner locks up a two-year PGA Tour exemption and Masters invite, while players on the bubble battle for top-125 and top-60 status.
rivalryAngle: Intense head-to-head leaderboard scrap between young PGA Tour University graduates and seasoned European tour qualifiers.
funFacts: The 36-hole cut of 2-under par sent 65 competitors into the weekend rounds on the Seaside Course.
Michael Thorbjornsen fired a second-round 64 on Friday to surge into a share of the lead.
Six different players entered Moving Day within three shots of the 9-under lead.
